properties.name: d365.api.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Web API (e.g., https://yourorg.crm5.dynamics.com/api/data/v9.2)

properties.name: d365.api.internal-domains
properties.description: List of internal email domains to exclude from customer detection (e.g., @bintara.com.my)

properties.name: d365.api.internal-shared-mailboxes
properties.description: List of known internal/shared mailboxes to exclude from customer detection (e.g., support@bintara.com.my)

properties.name: cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of allowed CORS origins for API access
